description: Multi-tenant sports-academy SaaS: static vanilla-JS tenant apps (LeoTennis, Machaxi) + operator consoles (Academy Manager, CourtSync) on GitHub Pages, all backed by one Supabase project (Postgres + RLS + Auth + Edge Function scaffolds). No build step anywhere; apps talk to Supabase over fetch with the anon key + per-role JWTs.

repos.LeoTennis: tenant app template + supabase/ platform SQL (schema.sql, lockdown.sql, launch-reset.sql, edge functions)
repos.Machaxi: second tenant app, cloned from LeoTennis (two-venue model)
repos.MatchPoint: tenant app for Match Point Badminton Academy (Manikonda, Hyderabad); MatchPointBadminton repo is the superseded prototype
repos.Raj Sports: web console for coach-operator Raj (5 centres, 5 sports) + its own migration/cron SQL (WhatsApp reminder engine)
repos.RajSportsApp: native Android client (Kotlin) for Raj Sports — same Supabase backend as the web console
repos.genalpha-glass-web: Gen Alpha Cricket Academy glass web app — runs on its OWN Supabase project (hwxhigwaklzedxufwedv); legacy repo cricket-academy-manager still serves genalphaacademy.in

nodes.label: Players & Parents
nodes.desc: Public users: book courts, submit admission enquiries, pay fees. No login.

nodes.label: Academy Staff
nodes.desc: Coaches/managers of one academy. Supabase Auth users with app_metadata {am_role:'staff', tenant_id}.

nodes.label: Platform Operator
nodes.desc: Runs the SaaS. Auth user with app_metadata {am_role:'operator'}; cross-tenant read access.

nodes.label: LeoTennis app
nodes.desc: Tenant 'leo'. Public pages (index, booking, admission, pay) + staff console (dashboard, bookings, players, fees, attendance). window.LT_CLOUD adapter, lt-* localStorage keys.

nodes.label: Machaxi app
nodes.desc: Tenant 'machaxi'. Same template as Leo; the sport dimension doubles as a two-venue court-pool key (rally R1-R6, urban U1-U7). mx-* localStorage keys (shared origin with Leo).

nodes.label: MatchPoint app
nodes.desc: Tenant 'matchpoint'. Staff-facing manager for Match Point Badminton Academy (Manikonda, Hyderabad): attendance, bookings, fees, renewals, player skill progress. Same template family.

nodes.label: Raj Sports web
nodes.desc: Tenant 'raj'. Coaching manager for a coach-operator running batches at venues he doesn't own (centres can take revenue share). Product priority: WhatsApp reminders that never give a parent a bad experience. Own migration adds enrollments, member_timeline, reminder_events, reminder_queue().

nodes.label: Raj Sports Android
nodes.desc: Native Android client for Raj Sports — same Supabase backend as the web console; a payment recorded on the phone shows on the laptop immediately.

nodes.label: Gen Alpha app
nodes.desc: Gen Alpha Cricket Academy (Hyderabad) — the platform's FIRST client; the shared schema was designed around it. Its glass web app currently runs on its own Supabase project; tracked in Academy Manager as an account (tenants + subscriptions rows for 'genalpha').

nodes.label: Academy Manager console
nodes.desc: Operator suite: portfolio KPIs, per-academy detail with live 7-day activity feed, billing, growth, platform health.

nodes.label: CourtSync console
nodes.desc: Operator's live channel-sync monitor across venues; venues connect their own channels, operator watches and triggers syncs.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth
nodes.desc: Password sign-in for staff + operator. Roles carried in app_metadata (am_role, tenant_id); anon key for public paths. Helpers auth_role()/auth_tenant() drive RLS.

nodes.label: PostgREST API
nodes.desc: Direct table reads/writes gated by RLS. Public may INSERT events + applications only; staff scoped to their tenant; operator reads all.

nodes.label: SQL RPCs
nodes.desc: Money & aggregate paths: request_booking (anon, server-side price + flood caps), record_booking, confirm_booking, cancel_booking, block_maintenance, propagate_block/unblock, sync_ingest, partner_sync, submit_application, operator_portfolio, platform_health, reconcile_report, get_channels…

nodes.label: Postgres tables
nodes.desc: tenants, subscriptions, integrations, bookings (unique slot index), members, payments, expenses, attendance, reminders_log, applications, events (telemetry), sync_jobs, platform_settings.

nodes.label: Derived views
nodes.desc: contacts (CRM deduped from bookings — read-only, can never break a booking) and public_slots (anon availability without PII).

nodes.label: sync_jobs queue
nodes.desc: Outbound cross-channel work (block/unblock per partner) enqueued transactionally; claimed with retry/backoff by the sync worker. Survives crashes — nothing is fire-and-forget.

nodes.label: pg_cron
nodes.desc: Schedules the sync worker (~30s), nightly reconcile + encrypted backup, cron_health_check heartbeat feeding platform_health.

nodes.label: Vault secrets
nodes.desc: Per-account partner credentials (partner:* secrets) referenced from integrations.config — never plaintext in tables.

nodes.label: Edge Functions
nodes.desc: sync-worker (drains sync_jobs), partner-webhook (inbound bookings), partner-poll (pull fallback), partner-push (outbound blocks), reconcile (nightly ledger diff + alert). Scaffolded, not yet deployed — DB dummy processor logs the block meanwhile.

nodes.label: Partner channels
nodes.desc: Marketplace booking channels. Bookings imported from them carry ext_ref; blocks are propagated to them so a slot sold anywhere closes everywhere.

nodes.label: WhatsApp
nodes.desc: Fee-renewal reminders with UPI pay links. Leo/Machaxi send from the staff roster (reminders_log); Raj runs the full ladder engine (reminder_events state machine, ported from Gen Alpha).

nodes.label: Gen Alpha Supabase
nodes.desc: hwxhigwaklzedxufwedv.supabase.co — Gen Alpha's own backend, not the shared platform project. Its operational data lives here until the tenant is migrated onto the shared schema.

edges.label: account of record in AM (tenants + subscriptions rows only — no live ops data yet)

flows.name: Player books a court
flows.summary: Public slot booking with server-side pricing, atomic court claim, and cross-channel blocking.

steps.title: Pick a slot
steps.detail: Player opens booking.html (no login); availability comes from the anon-safe public_slots view.

steps.title: request_booking RPC
steps.detail: Anon call: price computed server-side (slot_rate), phone required, per-phone + per-day flood caps, self-cleaning pendings.

steps.title: Pending row inserted
steps.detail: bookings row status 'pending'; the unique slot index (tenant, date, hour, court) holds the slot.

steps.title: Staff review
steps.detail: The request appears in the staff console bookings.html.

steps.title: confirm_booking RPC
steps.detail: Staff JWT required (lockdown guard). Court auto-claimed atomically via the <initial><n> claim loop.

steps.title: Cross-channel block enqueued
steps.detail: propagate_block writes one durable sync_jobs row per other connected channel.

steps.title: Scheduler fires
steps.detail: pg_cron wakes the sync-worker (~every 30s).

steps.title: Worker claims jobs
steps.detail: process_sync_jobs hands ready jobs to the worker with retry/backoff; failures land in dead letters.

steps.title: Slot blocked everywhere
steps.detail: Playo / Hudle / District get the block so the hour can't be double-sold.

flows.name: Staff walk-in booking
flows.summary: Manual booking entry by academy staff — the provenance trail AM uses to tell humans from imports.

steps.title: Open bookings.html
steps.detail: Staff console, signed in with a tenant-scoped staff JWT.

steps.title: record_booking RPC
steps.detail: Server computes the rate and claims a court; source set from the form (e.g. Walk-in).

steps.title: Confirmed row lands
steps.detail: bookings row status 'confirmed', created_at = now, no ext_ref — the manual-entry fingerprint.

steps.title: Telemetry event
steps.detail: LT_CLOUD.track('staff_booking_added', {source, venue}) inserts into events.

steps.title: Operator sees it
steps.detail: AM console's 7-day activity feed shows the action with time and detail.

flows.name: Partner booking import
flows.summary: A booking sold on a marketplace flows in via webhook and blocks the slot on every other channel.

steps.title: Webhook arrives
steps.detail: Playo/Hudle/District call partner-webhook when a booking happens on their side.

steps.title: Credential check
steps.detail: Per-account partner secret fetched from Vault (partner:* entries) — never plaintext.

steps.title: sync_ingest writes
steps.detail: Booking inserted with ext_ref set (the imported-booking fingerprint) and source = channel name.

steps.title: Counter-blocks enqueued
steps.detail: propagate_block queues block jobs for every other connected channel.

steps.title: Worker drains queue
steps.detail: sync-worker claims the jobs on the next cron tick.

steps.title: Other channels blocked
steps.detail: The slot closes across the remaining marketplaces.

flows.name: Usage telemetry → activity feed
flows.summary: Every tenant-app action becomes an event; the operator reads them as a per-academy activity feed.

steps.title: Any page opens
steps.detail: cloud.js logs page_view automatically (+ client_error telemetry with breadcrumbs); pages call LT_CLOUD.track for named actions.

steps.title: Anon event insert
steps.detail: POST /events with tenant_id, name, props, session_id, page — allowed for anyone by design (events_public_w).

steps.title: Row lands in events
steps.detail: Indexed (tenant_id, at); operator-only SELECT policy (events_op_r).

steps.title: Operator opens AM
steps.detail: Academy detail view for any tenant.

steps.title: Aggregates via RPC
steps.detail: operator_portfolio computes usage_daily, sessions, active days, last_event_at, errors per tenant.

steps.title: 7-day activity feed
steps.detail: AM queries raw events for the tenant: day-by-day actions, page-view summaries, session counts, 'No activity' idle days.

flows.name: Operator portfolio review
flows.summary: Cross-tenant KPIs with PII minimization — aggregates leave the tenant, phone lists never do.

steps.title: Open the console
steps.detail: AM console shell renders instantly, then hydrates.

steps.title: Operator sign-in
steps.detail: Password grant → JWT with app_metadata.am_role = 'operator'; refresh handled transparently.

steps.title: Three RPCs hydrate
steps.detail: operator_portfolio (per-tenant KPIs), platform_health (jobs, stale feeds, dead letters), reconcile_report (data gaps).

steps.title: Security-definer aggregates
steps.detail: Functions aggregate across tenants/bookings/events server-side; only account-level numbers cross the boundary.

steps.title: Rendered views
steps.detail: Insight KPIs + GMV trend, academy portfolio table, billing (paid/pending/overdue), growth channels, per-academy detail.

flows.name: Fee reminder → payment
flows.summary: Dues chase over WhatsApp with a UPI link, closed out by a recorded payment.

steps.title: Roster shows dues
steps.detail: players.html lists members with renewal dates approaching.

steps.title: WhatsApp reminder
steps.detail: Deep link opens a prefilled message with a UPI pay link; reminders_log records the send.

steps.title: reminder_sent event
steps.detail: Telemetry keeps the member timeline and AM feed accurate.

steps.title: Payment received
steps.detail: Parent pays; staff record it in fees.html (amount, mode).

steps.title: payments row + event
steps.detail: payments insert (staff RLS) + payment_recorded event → adoption + GMV metrics update.

flows.name: Admission enquiry
flows.summary: Public lead capture feeding the staff console and AM growth metrics.

steps.title: Public form
steps.detail: admission.html — program + contact details, no login.

steps.title: submit_application RPC
steps.detail: Anon insert path for applications (public write policy).

steps.title: Application stored
steps.detail: applications row, tenant-scoped; only staff/operator can read.

steps.title: admission_submitted event
steps.detail: Tracked with program + venue props.

steps.title: Shows up in AM Growth
steps.detail: apps_30d feeds the enquiries leaderboard and per-academy detail.

flows.name: Raj renewal reminder ladder
flows.summary: WhatsApp-first dues chasing for Raj Sports — the proven Gen Alpha ladder, tenant-scoped in SQL, driven by cron and mirrored on the staff screen.

steps.title: Renewal approaches
steps.detail: Raj's console tracks enrollments per centre; reminder_queue() computes exactly who is due and for how much.

steps.title: One function, two surfaces
steps.detail: The same reminder_queue() RPC feeds the cron auto-sender AND the staff click-to-send list — both surfaces always agree.

steps.title: The ladder schedule
steps.detail: -2d heads_up · 0d due · +5d first chase · +7..14d daily · +15d STOP — auto gives way to manual follow-up.

steps.title: WhatsApp send
steps.detail: Prefilled message + UPI pay link; reminder_events tracks queued → sent → delivered → read, failures → retry_scheduled.

steps.title: Timeline closes the loop
steps.detail: member_timeline appends the reminder and the eventual payment on the student profile.
